name: VRV System Service
tagline: Daikin VRV care for serious square footage
headline: Every indoor unit cold. Every error code answered.
summary: A Daikin VRV system runs your whole floor from one refrigerant circuit — when it falters, every cabin feels it. Airam services VRV networks across Chennai's offices and large villas: error-code diagnostics, branch selector checks, coil and piping care. Quotes are written on site, before work begins.

symptoms.title: Error codes on the controller
symptoms.description: A U-series or E-series code on the remote points to a communication, pressure or sensor fault that needs a proper readout, not another reset.

symptoms.title: One zone warm, others fine
symptoms.description: A struggling branch selector or a blocked refrigerant path can starve a single wing while the rest of the floor cools normally.

symptoms.title: Outdoor unit tripping
symptoms.description: Chennai's voltage fluctuations and 40°C rooftop heat push VRV compressors into protective shutdowns that grow more frequent until the cause is fixed.

symptoms.title: Oil stains along the piping
symptoms.description: Oil marks on refrigerant lines or ceiling tiles usually mean a slow leak that will eventually drag the entire circuit down.

symptoms.title: Power bills creeping up
symptoms.description: A VRV running low on gas or with fouled coils draws noticeably more power to deliver the same cooling across the floor.

symptoms.title: Stains on false ceilings
symptoms.description: Blocked drain lines above the ceiling grid show up as water marks long before they show up as drips on a workstation.

faqs.question: Do you only service Daikin VRV systems?
faqs.answer: VRV is Daikin's name for its variable refrigerant technology, and Daikin systems are the core of this work. We also service equivalent VRF systems from Mitsubishi Electric, LG, Blue Star and other major brands. The method carries across: error logs, pressure testing, branch-circuit checks.

faqs.question: Why can't you quote over the phone?
faqs.answer: A VRV fault can sit in the outdoor unit, a branch selector, or forty metres of piping in between. Quoting blind would mean padding the price to cover the unknowns. A site visit lets us quote the actual fault, in writing, before work starts.

faqs.question: Will servicing disrupt our office?
faqs.answer: Preventive work is done unit by unit, so the rest of the floor keeps cooling while we work overhead. For larger jobs we agree the sequence with your facilities team and schedule around working hours where we can.

faqs.question: One indoor unit shows an error. Is the whole system at risk?
faqs.answer: Sometimes. A single unit's fault can be local, like a sensor or a blocked drain, or the first symptom of a circuit-wide problem such as low refrigerant. The error-code readout is what separates the two, so avoid repeatedly resetting the breaker and hoping.

faqs.question: What does a VRV AMC cover?
faqs.answer: Scheduled preventive visits through the year, priority response on breakdowns, and a documented service history for every indoor unit. Pricing starts from ₹1,999 per indoor unit per year, with the exact scope fixed after a site survey.
